name: Thought Line
description: AI-style thinking indicator: a shimmering, breathing label with a glyph and live timer that settles into a 'Thought for 4.2s' line, with an optional collapsible list of steps.
contents: Inline status label with optional glyph (sparkle, dot, none or custom node)
Chevron and collapsible step list with check marks and a pulsing current step
behavior: While working, the label shimmers and the glyph breathes in opacity
On settle, the label crossfades with blur to the done label and the timer glides next to it
Timer counts up in 0.1s ticks, or follows the elapsed prop
Can auto settle after a set number of seconds
Steps list expands while working and collapses on settle, toggled by clicking the header
Reduced motion lowers breath depth, slows the breath and disables shimmer and blur
Calls onSettle with elapsed seconds when work finishes
editableByProps: Working and done labels, custom label rendering, glyph type and colors
Step list text, collapsing behavior, timer visibility and manual elapsed time
Text color, font size, breath, shimmer and settle timings
Auto settle delay and settle callback

needsCodeEdit.change: Replace the sparkle or tick icons
needsCodeEdit.where: Hugeicons imports (SparklesIcon, Tick02Icon, ArrowDown01Icon) at the top of the file
linear-gradient class on the breathRef span

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the dimmed opacity of the settled glyph

fixed: Does not control a done state by itself: the host sets working to false, or uses settleAfter, or elapsed
Component has no frame, it is an inline element that sits in the flow of the page

Uses CSS variables --tl-done and --tl-timer that are not defined in the component, so the done label and timer opacity depend on the host defining them or fall back to the browser default (fully opaque)
Injects keyframes through an inline style tag
Label and steps are single line (nowrap), long text can overflow on 360px screens
Uses the Tailwind starting: variant for step entry animation
